title: Bench: measuring mu0 with a solenoid (3D)
description: A wound solenoid, a current supply, an ammeter and a Hall probe at the centre. The current is stepped, B read (averaged), B(I) fitted; mu0 = slope sqrt(L^2 + 4 R^2) / N with L and R from a caliper. The field is the 3-D Biot-Savart field of the actual helix plus Earth's field. The result carries its uncertainty budget and is compared with CODATA 2022.
